about: AQ-02A task set. Each task is a scripted conversation (tool choice and answer are fixed here) replayed against a synthetic generation through the real tools, Ask loop and public MCP transport. Expected numbers carry the arithmetic that produces them from the fixture's raw cells; tests recompute them without the implementation. Scripted tool choice is not live-model quality. This file is not a baseline: nothing here is rebuilt from a run.

tasks.title: A wrong unit, year or entity is never reported as a verified claim

answer.ro: Cluj avea 1010 persoane în 2021. Iași avea 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Cluj had 1010 persons in 2021. Iași had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

negatives.describe: Presents the count as persons per resident.

answer.ro: Cluj avea 1010 persoane pe locuitor în 2021. Iași avea 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Cluj had 1010 persons per resident in 2021. Iași had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

negatives.describe: Moves the Cluj figure to 2020, in a sentence of its own.

answer.ro: Cluj avea 1010 persoane în 2020. Iași avea 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Cluj had 1010 persons in 2020. Iași had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

negatives.describe: Swaps the two counties' figures, one sentence each.

answer.ro: Iași avea 1010 persoane în 2021. Cluj avea 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Iași had 1010 persons in 2021. Cluj had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

negatives.describe: Moves the Cluj figure to 2020 inside one sentence that also states 2021 for Iași.

answer.ro: Cluj avea 1010 persoane în 2020, iar Iași 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Cluj had 1010 persons in 2020, and Iași had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

known_limitation.note: With two years in one sentence the period contradiction is not detected: both figures exist in the result and the sentence is accepted as verified (03B: multiple years stay ambiguous).

negatives.describe: Swaps the two counties' figures inside one sentence.

answer.ro: Iași avea 1010 persoane în 2021, iar Cluj 880 de persoane în 2021 (POPC).
answer.en: Iași had 1010 persons in 2021, and Cluj had 880 persons in 2021 (POPC).

known_limitation.note: Entity names are matched per sentence, so two entities and two values in one sentence cannot be told apart and the swap is accepted (03B: swapped assignments).

tasks.title: A reversed sign or endpoint swap on a change is never reported as a verified claim

prompt.ro: Cum s-a schimbat B între 1992 și 2002?
prompt.en: How did B change between 1992 and 2002?

answer.ro: B a avut o variație de -50 de persoane între 1992 și 2002, de la 200 la 150 (COUNTX).
answer.en: B changed by -50 persons between 1992 and 2002, from 200 to 150 (COUNTX).

negatives.describe: Says B grew by 50 when it fell by 50.

answer.ro: B a crescut cu 50 de persoane între 1992 și 2002, de la 200 la 150 (COUNTX).
answer.en: B increased by 50 persons between 1992 and 2002, from 200 to 150 (COUNTX).

known_limitation.note: 50 is matched against the absolute change -50 without the direction word; 'increased by 50' is accepted as a verified claim.

negatives.describe: Swaps the from and to values.

answer.ro: B a avut o variație de -50 de persoane între 1992 și 2002, de la 150 la 200 (COUNTX).
answer.en: B changed by -50 persons between 1992 and 2002, from 150 to 200 (COUNTX).

known_limitation.note: Both endpoint values exist in the result; with no 'from/to' year binding the swap is accepted as a verified claim.
